name: demo
description: Single-user demo. One validator approves or rejects the AI's code; the oracle (the server that generated the code, here the relayer address) penalizes a wrong approval immediately (no appeal window). Two mistakes reach stage 2 (100, then 100 + 100% = 300 >= 200); a third bans (>= 500). Fades fast (100 points per day) so recovery is visible; the liability window is long (365 days).
